main.description: A like on an activity, a post (app.activitytracker.feed.post) or a comment on either (app.activitytracker.feed.comment), told apart by the subject's collection. A like on a public subject is stored in the giver's repo, and any other in their app.activitytracker.space.athlete interactions space; a comment's tier is the narrower of its subject's visibility and its audience. A like on the giver's own subject is ignored.
